title: Haponita sweet potato (Haponita kamote): Characteristics
metaDescription: Haponita sweet potato is an introduced sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Haponita sweet potato is an introduced sweet potato variety, also sold or known as Haponita kamote. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from introduced (foreign sourced) cultivar.

heroImage.alt: Kamote vines on long raised ridges in San Rafael, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Haponita sweet potato is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Haponita kamote, this is the same sweet potato. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sweet potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/sweet-potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).
Key facts about Haponita sweet potato

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
It is recommended processing: ube style hopia, yogurt, candy.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Dark purple (violet) flesh, high in anthocyanin.
**Uses:** Processing: ube style hopia, yogurt, candy.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: dark purple kamote used by BSU as a stand in for ubi in hopia and yogurt, among DA CAR's seven distributed varieties. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Haponita sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is Haponita kamote the same as Haponita?
items.a: Yes. Haponita kamote is another name for Haponita. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Haponita?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
